title: UK asylum seekers not widely abusing modern slavery rules, report finds
summary: Exclusive: Thinktank’s findings undermine successive home secretaries’ statements about misuse of system in England and Wales Asylum seekers are not abusing the modern slavery system in a widespread manner, according to a report from a centre-right thinktank that undermines statements from successive home secretaries. The report from Bright Blue finds limited evidence that asylum seekers are falsely claiming to have been the victims of modern slavery to stay in the country, despite several home secretaries blaming the system for stopping them deporting more people.
